name: dusopp-skills
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace (Windows / .NET / Azure focused)

plugins.name: agent-guardrails
plugins.description: Block-only PreToolUse guard for catastrophic commands: az/azd/azcopy, Azure DevOps, Az PowerShell, dotnet nuget, git force-push, disk/registry wipes, destructive MCP tool calls. One denylist shared by Claude Code and GitHub Copilot (VS Code + CLI).

plugins.name: git-worktree
plugins.description: Run parallel coding agents safely via git worktrees on Windows/.NET: Claude Code native worktrees, manual worktrees for GitHub Copilot, .NET bootstrap (NuGet/user secrets/ports/LocalDB/EF), and Azure DevOps PR-based merge flow. Explicit invocation: /git-worktree.

plugins.name: goal-loop
plugins.description: Write effective goal contracts for persistent self-checking agent loops and launch them: Claude Code /goal, Copilot CLI /autopilot (alias /goal), VS Code Autopilot mode, Copilot cloud agent (GitHub repos only). Anti-reward-hacking rules, .NET validation commands, drift management. Explicit invocation: /goal-loop.

plugins.name: setup-help
plugins.description: Guided step-by-step setup walkthroughs - one atomic step at a time with a max-8-item list of remaining steps. Explicit invocation: /setup-help.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: Ask the agent to list every decision or choice it made during the current work that it is not confident about, for quick review. Explicit invocation: /decisions.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Bundle: install every dusopp skill at once. Depends on agent-guardrails, git-worktree, goal-loop, setup-help, and decisions (auto-installed); its install-copilot.ps1 wires the GitHub Copilot side of every plugin in one go.
